description: This file contains utility functions for managing module dependencies, determining affected modules based on file changes or git commits, and testing modules within a Spark project. It includes functions for traversing dependency graphs, identifying changed files, and computing test sets.

methods.name: determine_modules_for_files
methods.description: Returns the set of modules containing the specified files, defaulting to 'root' if no specific module is found.

methods.name: identify_changed_files_from_git_commits
methods.description: Determines which files have changed based on a git commit and target ref, used to identify affected modules.

methods.name: determine_modules_to_test
methods.description: Computes the transitive closure of changed modules' dependencies to determine which modules should be tested.

methods.name: determine_tags_to_exclude
methods.description: Returns test tags to exclude based on modules that have not changed.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctests within the module to verify correctness.
